report.root_cause: plugins/StatsCache/config.yml was edited at 06:53:16 to set retain-history: true; the StatsCache plugin hot-reloaded it (log 06:53:17 "config reloaded (retain-history=true)") and began retaining every stats snapshot in memory without bound. Heap climbed 387 MB -> 577 MB -> 754/768 MB within ~60 s; statscache stats showed 1520 entries holding ~434.9 MB. Who/what edited the file is not identified from the logs.
report.actions: 1) Baseline status + log review; noticed heap rising sharply and the StatsCache retain-history=true reload line. 2) Read plugins/StatsCache/config.yml (retain-history: true, history-size: 1000). 3) Declared incident at heap 754/768 MB. 4) Wrote plugins/StatsCache/config.yml back to retain-history: false (history-size left at 1000); plugin auto-reloaded (log 06:54:35 retain-history=false). 5) Ran 'statscache stats' (1520 entries, ~434.9 MB) then 'statscache flush' (freed ~434.9 MB). 6) Verified: heap dropped to ~297-336 MB and stayed flat over 55 s, TPS 20.0, MSPT ~2, 'statscache stats' shows 0 entries, no further config reloads in log. No restart, no player disconnects, no bans, no files deleted.
report.residual_risk: The actor that changed config.yml to retain-history: true is unknown; if it is a person or automation with write access, it could re-enable it and the leak would recur within ~1-2 minutes. Recommend auditing who edited the file and either capping StatsCache's history to a bounded size or removing the hot-reload path. The plugin's history-size: 1000 setting evidently did not bound retention (1520 entries accumulated), suggesting a plugin bug worth reporting upstream.
